answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation is a task of automatically producing text from non-linguistic input.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions from structured data such as databases, tables, and RDF triples

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate models' performance using automatic metric BLEU, and the BLEU scores are comparable to the mainstream research.

answer_4.quote: We hire five annotators with satisfactory levels in reading from eight candidates. They are all highly educated enough to understand structured data and tables, and their English level is also very high to understand the text.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are required to find all errors in the sentence and label them with error types and severity. Errors are categorized into accuracy and fluency aspects, with specific error types defined including Omission, Inaccuracy Intrinsic, Inaccuracy Extrinsic, Duplication, Word Form, and Word Order.
